messages:
Lina: Heads up  Acme Health wants to buy via AWS Marketplace but procurement says invoices must have PO on each line for 3-way match. They need a commit + soft cap on overages. Can we do this and still use Marketplace?
Ben: SE: POC metrics look good (2xA10G, p95 ~120ms for chat workload). They want seat-based licensing + usage tokens.
Raj: Finance: Public marketplace invoices won't include per-line PO. This breaks their AP.
Marta (Procurement, Acme): Confirmed. Our system rejects invoices unless line items contain PO number. Header-only PO isn't acceptable. Net30 required.
billing-bot: mp-note: AWS Marketplace public invoices do not expose buyer PO per-line. Private offers can pass invoice metadata; visibility depends on buyer ERP. See vendor docs: https://go.aws/marketplace/invoice
Lina: So public MP is out. Options? Private Offer with PO metadata, or Redwood invoices directly as seller-of-record. Tradeoffs?
Ben: Private Offer + commit is preferred: (1) allows passing customer_po in line-item metadata, (2) keeps AWS billing pipeline. Downsides: extra AWS processing and legal sign-off on PO terms.
Raj: Seller-of-record path is faster but Finance needs to accept AR and tax treatment. Also affects revenue recognition timing.
Marta: We need a sample invoice to run a test with our AP by EOD tomorrow. If PO appears on line items in that test, procurement can approve.
Ben: I'll prepare a rate card + SKU mapping and a sample invoice payload. Sample line-item metadata will look like: `{"sku": "REDW-SK-CHAT-01", "quantity": 10, "unit": "seat", "customer_po": "ACME-PO-98765"}`. Is that OK?
billing-bot: private-offer-fyi: AWS MP supports passing arbitrary invoice metadata in private offers. Final ERPs may still surface differently; recommend test invoice and include both header and line metadata.
Raj: From deal desk: for private offers we must confirm commit accounting (apply as prepaid credits vs monthly amortized). Revenue-ops, can you confirm treatment?
revenue-ops: Quick: we prefer prepaid credits applied monthly over the commit period for cleaner recognition. We can support both but need the sales contract to match. Allow 24-48h.
Lina: Timeline: Acme needs PO issued by next Monday to close this quarter. Can legal + rev-ops fast-track?
revenue-ops: We'll prioritize review. If private offer isn't viable in time, seller-of-record route is fallback but requires written finance sign-off.
Marta: If Redwood issues the invoice directly, we still need to validate taxes and remit details. That could delay acceptance on our side too.
Ben: Plan proposed: 1) I will upload draft rate card + SKU mapping to the deal doc (ETA: today EOD). 2) Send sample private-offer invoice payload for AP test (ETA: tomorrow morning). 3) Revenue-ops to confirm commit accounting (24-48h). 4) Legal to review private-offer addendum (48-72h) or we escalate.
Lina: I'll open an urgent deal-desk ticket and tag legal + rev-ops. Also request AWS MP rep help to expedite private-offer processing.
Marta: I'll queue the AP test for Tues morning if sample arrives. Need exact JSON payload.
Ben: Sample payload will be posted here and in the ticket. Example line:```{
  "line_item": {
    "sku": "REDW-SK-CHAT-01",
    "description": "Chat seats + tokens",
    "quantity": 10,
    "unit_price": 120,
    "customer_po": "ACME-PO-98765"
  }
}```
billing-bot: note: include invoice_date and invoice_number fields or some ERPs will ignore metadata.
revenue-ops: If we move forward with private offer, please ensure the contract language aligns with prepaid vs amortized commit. We'll attach revenue guidance to the deal ticket.
Lina: Deal ticket #5092 created and marked P0. Please keep updates in-thread. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
